purpose: Reviewed signing metadata for debug, androidTest and self-signed release APKs; no private key or certificate identity is enrolled by a build.

extensionSemantics.2.5.29.14: SHA-1 of the complete subjectPublicKey bit string, excluding unused-bits octet
extensionSemantics.2.5.29.35: keyIdentifier only, equal to the self-signed public key identifier

issuerPolicy: subject and issuer must be identical; no issuer/subject unique IDs or extra fields
knownArtifactScan: Every byte offset of the complete bounded APK signing block is checked against every fitting immutable HF artifact size/SHA-256; no external cache is read.
